styleException.description: panel's computed flex-basis (style: "flex: 0 0 {size}%;" at resizable.rs's ResizablePanel) and the drag overlay's runtime cursor (style: "cursor: {overlay_cursor};")
styleException.reason: A panel's size is a runtime percentage driven by drag/keyboard state; Tailwind has no static utility for an arbitrary runtime flex-basis percentage, matching progress.rs's identical precedent for its computed indicator width.

inspirationNote: No dedicated adico-primitives module -- see registry/ui/resizable.rs's own module doc comment for why (M7 task 8.4). Layout/handle classes (bg-border separator, focus-visible ring) match shadcn's own resizable source shape; the drag/keyboard interaction itself is this crate's own implementation, not ported from react-resizable-panels.
